alternativeIndependentValidation.method: Local JavaScript validator using its bundled Schema.org type and subclass maps; parsed the saved repository JSON-LD, traversed graph objects, removed JSON-LD control keys for vocabulary-property checking, and resolved local @id references when the target type was available.
alternativeIndependentValidation.limitation: Not an official Schema.org validator. It uses the third-party package’s bundled vocabulary maps with a temporary adapter that unions official ranges for valid multi-typed nodes. The homepage result validates selected representative graph nodes because the full page contains 7.6 MB of structured data. JSON-LD @id references are resolved to in-page types, or treated as the general Thing type when an external/forward target is absent.
